How to play
Four expedition suits, cards 2–10 plus two investment cards each; hand six. On turn play one card to own expedition in nondecreasing rank (investment only before numbers) or discard to shared suit pile, then draw stock or any other discard pile top. Each started suit scores (sum numbers −20)×(1+investments), including negative totals; eight cards adds 15. Stock depletion ends after current turn. Round also ends after six consecutive turns drawing from discards without any new expedition placement; a visible stagnation counter resets on stock draw or expedition play. Six consecutive discard-only turns without a stock draw or expedition placement end the round before the next draw; a 70-turn cap also settles current scores.
Higher total across three rounds wins; lower loses, equal draw. Negative expedition scores can erase successes.
